name: charts
title: Charts
description: A chart from data in the prompt (CSV, JSON or numbers in the text) as one SVG block in the house style - dark readout, cobalt series, signal-orange highlight, tabular numbers, units on the axes; line, bar, scatter, histogram, heatmap, sparkline, stat tile.

overlaps.ui-design: page layout, spacing and type rules stay there; this package is the chart alone (one svg block) and its data-readback contract
overlaps.matplotlib-plots: Python charts to PNG stay there; this package is SVG by hand in the browser style

contract: one svg block (viewBox 0 0 800 450); an html block only when the prompt asks for a page
